description: [LocalSim L2] simulation_runtime/scheduler.py: (a) naive datetime.now() (5300) + hardcoded CST windows incl. time(15,0) tagged tzinfo=UTC (4203), no ZoneInfo anywhere -> on a UTC backend the A-share session/EOD windows never match and EOD never fires; snapshot time is 8h off. (b) both terminalizers (_terminalize_stale_miniqmt_active_runs:2065, _terminalize_post_close_miniqmt_runs:2127) early-return for non-MINIQMT_SIM, so LocalSim runs are NEVER post-close/stale terminalized (stuck non-terminal across days). (c) cash silently defaults to 0.0 (3477) -> all buys SKIPPED. (d) roll-forward/inner run_once lack a trading-day gate. FIX: normalize all scheduler time to Asia/Shanghai (mirror live_session); add a LocalSim post-close + stale terminalizer mirroring the MiniQMT ones; fail-closed (DataUnavailableError) when context.cash is None; add a trading-day gate to inner run_once/roll-forward. MiniQMT logic untouched.
